statement: The complete compatible E80 family image, an actual fixed rational-cusp origin, and the full index-nine central comparison over its intrinsic abelian section, with all conjugacy-fibre inverse coordinates.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: A c-fixed path to the rational B0 cusp is normalized through the actual full joint quotient; its norm identity forces the origin N=2,M=3.
The entire E80 family has an intrinsic class-two preimage exactly when N+M=2 modulo3. Compatible target conjugacy classes are Z3, with coordinate N-M+1 and explicit inverse.
The full intrinsic class-two fibre over the specified abelian section is Z3^46 x C3^9 x C9^5. Its map to the target central fibre Z3^2 x C3 has image Z3 x 3Z3 x0 and cokernel C3^2.
Every fibre of this restricted full map is Z3^44 x C3^9 x C9^5, with exact retained Smith/kernel coordinate rows and inverse. The smaller cusp-family slice has fibres Z3^23 x C3^9 x C9^5.
Both splitting vectors are literal Hall brackets. The complete source coefficient map, all inverse matrices, saturated relative kernel and arithmetic intertwiners are saved.
Arbitrary other intrinsic abelian preimages are not identified with the specified abelian class. Their obstruction dependence is the next task; E23 is not declared solved.

Root independently read the entire proof and program, checked every frozen manifest file, and freshly ran a copied program against six copied arithmetic inputs. The complete program, stdout and JSON are byte-identical with no exclusions. The integration adds the explicit global-path/local-source typing through the same based Gamma action, as confirmed by the author. PASS.
